race.comment: CRUISERWEIGHT (3) is now 42 days between runs having been scratched at the barriers two weeks ago then failed to make the field last week. He's got plenty of ability and the tactical speed to hold a spot from barrier one, if he's right he's the one to beat. FUNDAMENTAL NATURE (4) won quite well the last time and the rating there stands out as the biggest hurdle in the path of CRUISERWEIGHT. Draws wide but that may well be a blessing in the potential conditions. QUEEN CHRISTINE (11) has won three on the bounce in nice style and should cross to lead with Meech on. She can measure up again. IVAN'S HERO (12) ran well behind her first up and should be fitter.
